title: Morning rush in Richmond Hill: every bus, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Richmond Hill, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Richmond Hill city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: YRT, Viva Blue and GO, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 67 buses at 7:48 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
